auth.signupDescription: Sign up to create your own essay portfolio.
auth.resetDescription: We'll send a reset link to your registered email address.
auth.resetSent: Email sent. Use the link in the email to set a new password.
auth.verifyDescription: We sent a verification email to {email}. Open the link in the email, then press the button below. If you can't find it, check your spam folder.
auth.verifyNotYet: Your email isn't verified yet. Open the link in the email and try again.

onboarding.title: Choose your username
onboarding.description: Your username becomes the URL of your portfolio.
onboarding.rules: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (-)
onboarding.errorFormat: Use 3–20 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens (-).
onboarding.errorReserved: This username is reserved and can't be used.
onboarding.cannotChange: Note: you can't change your username later.

dashboard.title: Essays
dashboard.description: Only published essays appear on your portfolio.
dashboard.limitReached: You've reached the limit of 200 essays
dashboard.empty: No essays yet. Click “New essay” to start writing.

essay.publishedHint: Published. It will appear on your portfolio within about a minute.
essay.deleteDescription: “{title}” will be deleted. This can't be undone.
essay.tooLarge: The body is too long to save. Please split it into several essays.
essay.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page?

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Saved changes appear at the top of your portfolio.
profile.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5MB. Shown cropped to a square.

uploadError.type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
uploadError.size: Choose an image of 5MB or less.
uploadError.failed: Upload failed. Please try again later.
uploadError.notConfigured: Image storage (Cloudinary) isn't configured. Please contact the administrator.

profile.name: Name

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose the colors and mood of your portfolio. Changes apply when you save.
theme.accentDescription: Used for buttons, the cursor and links.
theme.lowContrast: Contrast with the background is only {ratio}, which may be hard to read (3 or more is recommended).

settings.title: Account settings
settings.languageDescription: Changes the interface language of the editor and your portfolio (essay text stays as written).
settings.googleAccount: You signed in with Google, so manage your password in your Google account.
settings.deleteDescription: All your data — profile, essays and photo — will be deleted. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete your account. Please try again later.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.auth/weak-password: Use at least 8 characters for your password.
errors.auth/too-many-requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.auth/requires-recent-login: For security, please log in again and retry.
errors.auth/network-request-failed: Network error. Check your internet connection.
errors.permission-denied: You don't have permission to do this.

portfolio.siteTagline: A portfolio for your essays — and for you.
portfolio.siteDescription: Publish your essays with a design that feels like you. Free to join — just share the link and anyone can make their own portfolio.
portfolio.siteFeature1Body: Pick Pop, Natural, Monotone or Night, then fine-tune the color.
portfolio.siteFeature2Body: Titles that react to your cursor and lists that rise as you scroll.
portfolio.siteFeature3Body: A simple editor with bold, headings and quotes — and autosave.
portfolio.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or isn't public.
